items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: He played with Buck Vandal on and off.

ctx.x: I remember something I wanted to ask you before I forget it. How did you happen to remember all these nicknames of guys? Like Johnny Frisco, you told me he had a nickname. Yeah, Newfoot. Well, uh... You knew him well?

Yeah. He played with Buck Vandal on and off. And he was with... Happy Shilling for a long time. And some of Buck Vandal's band was with him also. Mm-hmm. And they all had nicknames, huh? Fonz? Fonz? Yeah, Fonz. Well, we used to call him Sack or Goat.
